questions.q: A whispering gallery has an elliptical ceiling 40 m long and 24 m high at the center (so $a = 20$ and $b = 12$, with the major axis horizontal). Two people stand at the foci. How far apart are they, to one decimal place?
questions.answer: $c = \sqrt{400 - 144} = \sqrt{256} = 16$, so the foci are $2c = 32.0$ m apart.

questions.q: Complete the square to write $4x^2 + y^2 - 8x + 6y + 9 = 0$ in standard form, and state the center.
Compute the eccentricity of each ellipse, and state which is more circular (closer to $e=0$):

A planet's elliptical orbit has semi-major axis $a = 150$ million km and eccentricity $e = 0.02$. Find the distance from the center to a focus, $c$, and hence the closest approach distance to the sun ($a - c$), to two decimal places (in millions of km).
questions.answer: $c = ea = 0.02(150) = 3$ million km. Closest approach $= a - c = 150 - 3 = 147.00$ million km.
